items.title: Trump’s $15 billion defamation case against New York Times may proceed, judge rules
items.description: A ​federal judge on Thursday said President Donald Trump’s $15 billion defamation lawsuit against the New York Times and book ‌publisher Penguin Random House may proceed, a victory for Trump in his legal campaign against media companies he accuses of treating him unfairly. Trump has filed several lawsuits against media companies since 2024, alleging they defamed him or fraudulently misled the public with false coverage. His critics have denounced the ​lawsuits as attacks on the free press. Thursday’s ruling came a week after another federal judge said Trump’s defamation lawsuit against ​the BBC over a misleadingly edited clip may proceed. The BBC has denied liability for defamation. The lawsuit against the New York Times and Penguin Random House cited a book about Trump by two New York ​Times reporters and what it characterised as “false, malicious, defamatory, and disparaging” articles that he says were aimed at sabotaging his chances ​in the 2024 presidential election, which he won. Trump seeks at least $15 billion in damages. US District Judge Steven Merryday in Tampa, Florida, said Trump’s complaint plausibly alleged that statements in a Times article by Peter Baker and a book by journalists Susanne Craig and Russ Buettner that accused ​Trump of “planning and perpetrating complex crimes” were “based on incomplete, minimal information.” The judge dismissed Trump’s claims over a Times article about ​his work on the reality TV show “The Apprentice.” The Times and Penguin have denied defaming Trump and said in a court filing that his ‌case is ⁠legally flawed and aimed at scoring political points. A Times spokesman said in a statement that Trump’s lawsuit had no legal merit and was “a baseless attack on The Times and the rights of the free and independent press in this country.” A spokesman for Trump’s personal legal team praised the ruling and said the defendants “will now have to answer for intentionally and maliciously defaming President ​Trump.” A Penguin Random House spokesperson ​said in a statement that ⁠it stands by the book and its authors and is confident the case will be fully dismissed. The lawsuit against the Times and Penguin concerned two articles and a book that cast doubt on Trump’s origin story as a savvy businessman who rose in the real estate and entertainment industries. Trump ⁠cited more than two dozen statements from Times articles by the three journalists and a book by Craig and Buettner titled “Lucky Loser: How Donald Trump Squandered His Father’s Fortune and Created the Illusion of Success.” They include assertions about Trump’s role in creating his hit reality TV show “The Apprentice,” his inheritance from his father, his business ventures, and his upbringing in New York City. The Times and Penguin said in a motion to dismiss that Trump’s lawsuit failed to explain how the statements were defamatory and included subjective ​opinions that cannot be proven true or false.

items.title: Accused child sex predator Thomas Markle ruled competent to face trial
items.description: A U.S. judge in Florida on Thursday declared Thomas Markle, the ​estranged father of Britain’s Duchess of Sussex, Meghan ‌Markle, to be mentally competent to answer to a federal charge filed in court earlier this month accusing him of being a ​child sexual predator. Agreeing with the findings of ​a court-appointed forensic psychiatrist, US Magistrate Judge ⁠Lindsay Griffin ruled that the 82-year-old father-in-law of ​Prince Harry was mentally fit to understand the proceedings ​against him and to properly assist in his own defense. He was charged November 5 in a criminal complaint with a ​single felony count of possessing child sexual abuse ​images. According to an FBI affidavit filed with the complaint, the ‌material ⁠in question, including two explicit photos of Markle posed with a naked underage girl and other images of him with children in various stages of ​undress, was found ​in two ⁠Los Angeles storage units. Commenting on the case at the time of his arrest ​on November 6 at an assisted-living ​center ⁠in Florida, FBI Director Kash Patel said Markle had “targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through ⁠his ​criminal actions.”

items.title: Syrian Arab Republic: Population Mobility and Baseline Assessment — Round 20 (01–30 September 2026)
items.description: Countries: Syrian Arab Republic, Jordan, Lebanon, Türkiye Source: International Organization for Migration Please refer to the attached file. Since the transition of power on 8 December 2024, the Syrian Arab Republic (hereafter referred to as Syria) has experienced substantial shifts in its humanitarian, political, and demographic landscape. Population movements remain dynamic, with returns recorded across all 14 governorates alongside continued displacement. While changing security conditions have influenced mobility patterns, persistent gaps in housing, livelihoods, and access to essential services continue to affect the ability of returnees to re-establish their lives and sustain their return. The escalation of hostilities across the Middle East since 28 February 2026 has further influenced displacement dynamics, contributing to continued cross-border movements. This report presents mobility trends recorded during September 2026 by the International Organization Migration's (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM), together with updated baseline estimates for Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs), IDP returnees within Syria, and arrivals from abroad, including both those returning to their areas of origin and those settling elsewhere. This report should be read alongside Communities of Return Index Round 5 for additional context. The findings in this report provide an evidence base to support humanitarian response, early recovery programming and planning for durable solutions.

items.title: Instagram offre désormais 15 minutes pour modifier une story après sa publication
items.description: Instagram introduit une nouvelle fonctionnalité qui devrait éviter bien des suppressions inutiles. Les utilisateurs peuvent désormais modifier une story pendant les 15 minutes suivant sa publication, sans perdre les vues, mentions J’aime ou réponses déjà enregistrées. Une faute de frappe, une musique oubliée ou encore un sticker mal positionné ne nécessiteront bientôt plus de supprimer une story pour la republier. Instagram permet désormais de modifier une story après sa mise en ligne, offrant à ses utilisateurs un délai de 15 minutes pour corriger leur publication. La nouveauté a été annoncée mercredi 18 novembre par Adam Mosseri, le patron d’Instagram. Elle permet notamment de retoucher différents éléments d’une story déjà publiée, sans repartir de zéro. Concrètement, les utilisateurs peuvent modifier le texte, la musique, les stickers ou encore les dessins ajoutés à leur story. L’un des principaux avantages de cette fonctionnalité est que ces changements ne remettent pas les compteurs à zéro. Les vues, mentions J’aime et réponses déjà reçues sont ainsi conservées. Une correction effectuée dans les minutes suivant la publication ne nécessite donc plus de supprimer la story et de perdre l’engagement déjà généré. Pour accéder à l’outil, il suffit d’ouvrir la story concernée, de cliquer sur le menu représenté par les trois petits points en bas à droite, puis de sélectionner l’option permettant de la modifier. Cette possibilité avait été repérée dès avril dernier par le développeur Alessandro Paluzzi, connu pour identifier des fonctionnalités en cours de développement dans les applications du groupe Meta. Après plusieurs mois de tests et de développement, Instagram passe désormais au déploiement officiel de cette nouvelle option. items.description: While his cousin sexually assaulted a then 25-year-old woman, a former Singapore Police Force (SPF) station inspector kissed the woman without her consent. On Thursday, Mohamad Joppri Harpawi, 44, pleaded guilty to one count of molestation. He was sentenced to four months’ jail. The victim cannot be named due to a gag order. SPF said that it initiated investigations against Joppri upon establishing his involvement in the case. He was immediately removed from frontline duties and later resigned...

Ringleader pleads guilty to $100 million US jewellery heist
items.description: The ringleader in a spate of truck burglaries pleaded guilty on Thursday to a federal robbery charge for his role in stealing roughly $100 million ​worth of jewellery from an armoured vehicle five years ago in California, considered ‌the largest such heist in US history, prosecutors said. Carlos Victor Mestanza Cercado, 33, an Ecuadorean national arrested two years ago in Panama during a layover on a flight from Guatemala to his home country, was one ​of seven men indicted on charges of robbing a Brink’s truck at a ​highway rest stop north of Los Angeles on July 11, 2022. The armoured vehicle ⁠was plundered while carrying 73 sacks of precious gems and fine jewellery from a ​major exhibition in the San Francisco Bay Area to a Southern California storage facility. Mestanza and his ​accomplices followed the jewellery shipment in multiple vehicles for 300 miles (480 km), coordinating by cellphone, then broke into the armoured truck while it was parked at a rural Kern County rest stop and fled with 24 bags of treasure, authorities said. The stolen collection of ​fine gold, diamonds, rubies, emeralds and luxury watches were valued at approximately $100 million, marking the largest US ‌jewelry heist ⁠on record, according to the US Attorney’s Office in Los Angeles. Under an agreement with prosecutors signed earlier this month, Mestanza pleaded guilty to one count of interference with commerce by robbery, a felony punishable by up to 20 years in prison, in exchange for prosecutors dropping several other charges he faced. Sentencing ⁠was set for April 15. In addition to the jewellery heist, Mestanza admitted to taking part with his co-defendants in the highway robberies of ​electronics being shipped by several trucks in March 2022. A statement ​from the ⁠U.S. Attorney’s Office in Los Angeles announcing his guilty plea described Mestanza as “the lead defendant in the case.” Three of Mestanza’s co-defendants are scheduled for trial in federal court in Los Angeles in March 2027. ​Two others remain at large, and a seventh accused ​member of their gang has been deported. Court documents do not make clear whether any of the stolen jewellery from the heist was ever recovered.

items.title: Obalende MTN bus park to open December, accommodate 1,000 buses — Wahab
items.description: By Olasunkanmi Akoni The Lagos State Government has said the ongoing redevelopment of the Obalende Bus Park, known as the Y’ello Bus Park, will be completed and ready for public use by the end of December 2026. The facility, being developed by MTN Nigeria as part of its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiative, is designed to accommodate more than 1,000 buses. Commissioner for the Environment and Water Resources, Tokunbo Wahab, disclosed this during an inspection tour of the Obalende project and another MTN-sponsored under-bridge recreational park at Falomo, Ikoyi. Wahab, who was accompanied by key government officials, including the Special Adviser to the Governor on Transportation, Sola Giwa; Special Adviser on Environment, Engr. Adekunle Akodu; General Manager of the Lagos State Parks and Gardens Agency (LASPARK), Adetoun Popoola; and Director of Drainage Services, Engr. Mahamood Adegbite, said the six-week completion window was agreed upon after consultations with stakeholders to resolve operational challenges. He explained that the project was initially scheduled for completion within 21 weeks following an inspection of the area by Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu and his deputy as part of efforts to transform the previously degraded environment into a modern transport hub. However, construction was delayed by logistical challenges involving existing transport operators conducting business at the site. Wahab said the government had engaged the transport unions, contractors and the Special Adviser on Transportation to agree on temporarily relocating operators from the immediate construction area to enable the contractors to complete the work. “Today was just to see how far they’ve gone. Thankfully, they had one or two logistics issues that had to do with the businesses that have been operating there, legacy things like the transport business. “We had to engage the Special Adviser to the Governor on Transportation, the transport unions, and the contractors to see how we can give them a space for a maximum of six weeks—not shutting the place down 100 per cent, but moving them out of that immediate workspace to enable the contractors to complete it and hand it over to them to operate,” he said. The upgraded facility is designed to accommodate approximately 1,000 buses and will feature dedicated parking and loading bays, sleeping facilities for drivers, modern toilet facilities and green areas. The design also incorporates collapsible barriers along the perimeter to allow drainage maintenance teams access to the adjoining canal for regular cleaning and maintenance. Addressing concerns about possible commercialisation of the facility and increases in transport fares, Giwa assured commuters and commercial transport operators that access to the terminal would be free. “No, there’s no toll at all. It is for them; they are the ones using it. We are just making it a standard park that we will replicate all over the state as time goes on,” he said. On the management of the facility after completion, Giwa said it would remain the property of the Lagos State Government under the supervision of the Ministry of Transportation. He added that the government was working with transport unions to ensure effective utilisation of the facility and prevent its takeover by miscreants. Giwa also warned commercial bus drivers against picking up passengers or parking along road corridors outside the designated terminal after its opening. He said the Lagos State Traffic Management Authority (LASTMA) would enforce compliance with traffic regulations. “By the time we finish this place, there will be no need for us to have any bus on the road, and Lagos State Traffic Management Authority, LASTMA, will be on the ground to ensure they comply with all the rules and regulations of Lagos State. “The laws are there. No one is above the law. We have provided the park for you, and if you come out of that park to obstruct traffic, definitely the law will take its course,” he warned. Falomo under-bridge gets recreational park Following the inspection at Obalende, the delegation visited the Falomo under-bridge, where MTN is also transforming a previously degraded space into a recreational park for public use. Speaking at the site, LASPARK General Manager, Popoola, said the area, which was previously characterised by indiscriminate waste dumping and misuse, was being reclaimed as a relaxation centre for residents. She said the facility would follow the model of the JJT Park in Alausa and remain open to the public free of charge for everyday recreational activities. However, corporate organisations and other groups seeking to organise formal events or competitions at the venue would be required to pay a nominal maintenance fee, she added. The Obalende project was formally handed over to MTN Nigeria by the Lagos State Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources on April 15, 2026, with an initial 21-week completion target. The September 11 deadline was missed following delays attributed to heavy rainfall between June and August and operational challenges involving existing park management. Construction resumed in mid-October, with clearing, foundation work and material deliveries, while interlocking pavement, curbing and fencing works were ongoing as of mid-November. The wider redevelopment plan also includes electric vehicle charging points, more than 60 public toilet fixtures, a recycling drop-off station, kiosks and commercial spaces, solar lighting and tree planting. Other components include a Lagos Waste Management Authority (LAWMA) road camp for street sweepers and security personnel, improved lighting and CCTV facilities, as well as maintenance arrangements for the park and adjoining Macgregor Canal. The post Obalende MTN bus park to open December, accommodate 1,000 buses — Wahab appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Compte rendu du Conseil des ministres du jeudi 19 novembre 2026
items.description: Le Conseil des ministres s’est tenu à Ouagadougou, le jeudi 19 novembre 2026, en séance ordinaire, de 09 H 00 min à 14 H 00 min, sous la présidence du Camarade Capitaine Ibrahim TRAORE, Président du Faso, Président du Conseil des ministres. Il a délibéré sur les dossiers inscrits à son ordre du jour, entendu des communications orales, procédé à des nominations, et autorisé des missions à l’étranger. I. DELIBERATIONS I.1. AU TITRE DE LA PRESIDENCE DU FASO Le Conseil a adopté deux (02) rapports. Le premier rapport est relatif à un projet de décret portant approbation des statuts particuliers de la Société d’Etat dénommée « Economat des Forces de défense et des Forces de sécurité », en abrégé « Economat-FDFS ». L’adoption de ce décret permet de doter la Société d’Etat Economat des Forces de défense et des Forces de sécurité de textes règlementaires en vue d’accomplir efficacement ses missions, conformément à la loi n°025/99/AN du 16 novembre 1999 portant règlementation générale des sociétés à capitaux publics. Le second rapport est relatif à l’inscription du « Projet RAAGA » sur la liste des projets spécifiques du Bureau national des Grands projets du Burkina (BN-GPB). Le « Projet RAAGA » porte sur la construction et l’aménagement de marchés modernes dans les arrondissements n°01 et n°04 de la ville de Ouagadougou et à Sarfalao à Bobo-Dioulasso. Il prévoit des complexes de marchés intégrés composés entre autres : – d’un bâtiment principal de type R+3 comprenant des étalages, un local sécurité, des sanitaires, des aires de restauration et diverses boutiques ; – des ouvrages annexes comprenant une infirmerie, une administration, un parking en silo pour permettre d’optimiser l’occupation des espaces ; – des bornes de recharges pour les véhicules électriques ; – des guichets automatiques de banque et de transfert d’argent. La mise en œuvre du « Projet RAAGA » permettra de renforcer la contribution du secteur commercial à la croissance économique nationale et de soutenir la dynamique de souveraineté économique et de développement endogène portée par la Révolution progressiste populaire. Le coût global de ce projet s’élève à 104 379 023 379 F CFA. Le financement est assuré par le budget de l’Etat. I.2. AU TITRE DU MINISTERE DE L’AGRICULTURE, DE L’EAU, DES RESSOURCES ANIMALES ET HALIEUTIQUES Le Conseil a adopté deux (02) décrets. Le premier décret porte modification des statuts particuliers du Fonds d’intervention pour l’environnement. Ce décret vise la modification du décret n°2015-901/PRES-TRANS/PM/ MEF/MERH du 27 juillet 2015 portant statuts particuliers du Fonds d’intervention pour l’environnement (FIE). Les innovations du décret sont entre autres : – la mise en conformité avec les nouveaux textes régissant les établissements publics et ceux définissant les attributions des départements ministériels ; – la redéfinition des missions du FIE pour consacrer son rôle d’instrument national de mobilisation, de gestion et d’allocation des ressources destinées à la protection de l’environnement, à la lutte contre les changements climatiques et à la promotion du développement durable ; – la diversification des modalités d’appui par l’introduction de nouveaux instruments financiers notamment les prêts concessionnaires et les prises de participation en complément des subventions. L’adoption de ce décret permet de doter le Fonds d’intervention pour l’environnement de nouveaux textes règlementaires en vue d’accomplir efficacement ses missions. Le second décret porte approbation des statuts particuliers révisés de FASO KOSAM. Ce décret est une relecture du décret n°2024-1766/PRES/PM/ MARAH/MICA/MEF du 31 décembre 2024 portant approbation des statuts particuliers de FASO KOSAM. Les principales innovations du décret sont : – la création d’un poste de Secrétaire général ; – la création de quatre (04) agences laitières dans les principaux bassins laitiers du pays. Il s’agit de l’Agence KOSAM du Centre, l’Agence KOSAM de l’Est, l’Agence KOSAM de l’Ouest et de l’Agence KOSAM du Nord ; – la reconfiguration du Conseil d’administration. L’adoption de ce décret permet de doter la société FASO KOSAM de nouveaux textes règlementaires en vue d’accomplir efficacement ses missions. I.3. AU TITRE DU MINISTERE DE L’ADMINISTRATION TERRITORIALE ET DE LA MOBILITE Le Conseil a adopté deux (02) décrets. Le premier décret porte nomination d’un Administrateur au Conseil d’orientation et de contrôle de l’Agence nationale de l’aviation civile (ANAC). L’adoption de ce décret permet la nomination du camarade Boulmonli Léonard LOMPO, Mle 104 413 C, Conseiller des affaires étrangères, Administrateur représentant l’Etat, au titre du ministère des Affaires étrangères au Conseil d’orientation et de contrôle de l’Agence nationale de l’aviation civile pour un premier mandat de trois (3) ans. Le second décret porte dissolution du Syndicat des pharmaciens du Burkina Faso (SPBF). Le coefficient appliqué au prix de cession des produits de spécialité est fixé au Burkina Faso à 1,32 depuis 1994. Entre février 2022 et janvier 2023, le Syndicat des pharmaciens du Burkina Faso a adressé plusieurs correspondances aux quatre grossistes-répartiteurs, en leur imposant de nouveaux coefficients nonobstant les textes en vigueur. Les sociétés Laborex Burkina, Tedis Pharma, Ubipharm ont donné suite à ces lettres en appliquant le coefficient de 1,48 sur les factures dès février 2023, à l’exception de la société Distribution pharmaceutique du Burkina Faso (DPBF). L’application de ce coefficient de 1,48 a entraîné une hausse des prix des médicaments de spécialité. A la suite de ces faits et après plusieurs enquêtes, la Commission nationale de la concurrence et de la consommation (CNCC) a saisi la Commission de l’UEMOA. Celle-ci par décision n°04/2026/COM/UEMOA du 27 février 2026, a établi que le SPBF et les trois grossistes-répartiteurs précités ont enfreint les dispositions du Traité de l’UEMOA. Elle a infligé une amende d’un million (1 000 000) F CFA au syndicat des pharmaciens et de cinquante millions (50 000 000) F CFA à chacun des trois grossistes-répartiteurs. La société DPBF a été mise hors de cause. Cette amende communautaire ne dispense pas l’Etat de tirer les conséquences des faits constatés à l’initiative d’une autorité burkinabè et supportées par les malades. Par conséquent, l’Etat a décidé de la dissolution du Syndicat des pharmaciens du Burkina Faso. L’adoption de ce décret permet la dissolution du Syndicat des pharmaciens du Burkina Faso, conformément à la loi n°011-2025/ALT du 17 juillet 2025 portant liberté d’association au Burkina Faso. I.4. AU TITRE DU MINISTERE DES AFFAIRES ETRANGERES Le Conseil a adopté un rapport relatif à une demande d’agrément pour la nomination d’un Ambassadeur Extraordinaire et Plénipotentiaire de la République du Rwanda auprès du Burkina Faso. Le Conseil a marqué son accord pour la nomination de Monsieur Moses RUGEMA, en qualité d’Ambassadeur Extraordinaire et Plénipotentiaire de la République du Rwanda auprès du Burkina Faso. I.5. AU TITRE DU MINISTERE DE LA JUSTICE Le Conseil a adopté deux (02) rapports. Le premier rapport est relatif aux projets spécifiques du ministère de la Justice. Ces projets spécifiques concernent la réalisation des études techniques, le suivi-contrôle et la construction du Palais de Justice de Bobo-Dioulasso (phase 1). Le coût global de ces projets spécifiques est de cinq milliards neuf cent cinquante-deux millions cent soixante-deux mille neuf cent soixante-cinq (5 952 162 965) F CFA TTC. Le financement est assuré par le budget de l’Etat. Le second rapport est relatif à un projet de décret portant nomination des membres de l’Autorité de régulation de la communication et du traitement des données à caractère personnel (ARCOD). L’adoption de ce décret permet la nomination de dix (10) membres à l’Autorité de régulation de la communication et du traitement des données à caractère personnel, conformément à la loi organique n°38-2026/ALP du 03 août 2026 portant dénomination, attributions, composition, organisation et fonctionnement de l’Autorité de régulation de la communication et du traitement des données à caractère personnel. I.6. AU TITRE DU MINISTERE DE LA SANTE Le Conseil a adopté quatre (04) rapports. Le premier rapport est relatif à un projet de décret portant approbation des statuts particuliers de l’Agence burkinabè de médecine traditionnelle et alternative (ABMTA). L’adoption de ce décret permet de doter l’Agence burkinabè de médecine traditionnelle et alternative de textes règlementaires en vue d’accomplir efficacement ses missions. Le deuxième rapport est relatif à un projet de décret portant approbation des statuts particuliers de « Faso Center for Disease Control and prevention », en abrégé « Faso CDC ». L’adoption de ce décret permet de doter Faso Center for Disease Control and prevention de textes règlementaires en vue d’accomplir efficacement ses missions. Le troisième rapport est relatif à des projets spécifiques du ministère de la Santé. Ces projets concernent la construction, l’équipement, le suivi architectural et le suivi-contrôle des travaux des Centres hospitaliers régionaux universitaires (CHRU) de Fada N’Gourma, Kaya, Koudougou et Banfora. Ils s’inscrivent dans le cadre de la mise en œuvre de la phase I (2026-2030) du Projet de construction et d’équipement de neuf (09) Centres hospitaliers régionaux universitaires (PCE/CHRU) d’une capacité de 500 lits chacun. Le coût de réalisation (construction et équipement) des quatre (04) CHRU s’élève à 324 000 000 000 F CFA hors taxe (HT). Le suivi architectural et le suivi-contrôle des travaux des quatre (04) CHRU se chiffrent à 2 400 000 000 F CFA TTC. Le financement est assuré par le budget de l’Etat. Le Conseil a instruit les ministres chargés du dossier de redimensionner le projet de construction du CHRU de Dédougou et d’y intégrer un Centre moderne de radiothérapie. Le quatrième rapport est relatif à des projets spécifiques du ministère de la Santé pour des activités critiques de préparation à la riposte contre d’éventuelles maladies infectieuses. Ces projets spécifiques visent à rendre opérationnels des centres de traitement des maladies infectieuses, aménager des sites de quarantaine pour les personnes contacts et constituer des stocks suffisants d’équipements et de protection des soignants. Le montant global de ces projets s’élève à un milliard cinq cent-vingt-un millions trente-neuf mille deux cent vingt-neuf (1 521 039 229) F CFA. Le financement est assuré par le budget de l’Etat. I.7. AU TITRE DU MINISTERE DE L’INDUSTRIE, DU COMMERCE ET DE L’ARTISANAT Le Conseil a adopté trois (03) décrets. Le premier décret porte approbation des statuts de la société d’économie mixte dénommée Société viticole du Burkina (SOVIB). L’adoption de ce décret permet de doter la Société viticole du Burkina de textes règlementaires en vue d’accomplir efficacement ses missions. Le deuxième décret porte approbation des statuts particuliers de l’Agence burkinabè de l’investissement et de promotion des exportations (ABIPEX). L’adoption de ce décret permet de doter l’Agence burkinabè de l’investissement et de promotion des exportations de textes réglementaires en vue d’accomplir efficacement ses missions. Le troisième décret porte création d’une société d’Etat dénommée Economat des Forces de défense et des Forces de sécurité (Economat-FDFS). L’Economat des Forces de défense et des Forces de sécurité a entre autres pour missions : – d’acquérir, de stocker et de gérer des denrées alimentaires et marchandises diverses ; – de mener des activités de transformation, de conditionnement, de traitement et de valorisation de produits agroalimentaires et industriels ; – de développer la production des filières locales (riziculture, élevage, pêche, agro-industrie) en lien avec ses besoins d’approvisionnement ; – de mener toute opération commerciale ou industrielle, mobilière, immobilière, financière, civile. Le capital social de l’Economat-FDFS est fixé à 1 000 000 000 F CFA. L’adoption de ce décret permet la création de la société d’Etat dénommée Economat des Forces de défense et des Forces de sécurité. I.8. AU TITRE DU MINISTERE DE L’ENERGIE, DES MINES ET DES CARRIERES Le Conseil a adopté un décret portant octroi d’un permis d’exploitation industrielle de grande mine de zinc à la Société de participation minière du Burkina Faso (SOPAMIB) PERKOA SA. La mine de zinc de Perkoa est située dans la commune de Réo, province du Sanguié, région de Nando. Cette mine avait fait l’objet d’un permis d’exploitation octroyé à la Société Nantou Mining Burkina Faso SA pour une durée de 20 ans. Elle a suspendu ses activités d’extraction industrielle à la suite de la tragédie survenue le 16 avril 2022. Cette suspension prolongée a entraîné des répercussions socio-économiques majeures notamment la perte d’emplois au niveau local, la perte de recettes fiscales et douanières pour l’Etat. La reprise des opérations par la SOPAMIB vise à sécuriser le patrimoine minier national, à relancer l’économie locale et à garantir une exploitation conforme aux exigences environnementales et de sécurité les plus strictes. La production totale attendue est estimée à 576 000 tonnes de concentré polymétallique pour une durée de vie de la mine estimée à 04 ans. Les investissements prévus s’élèvent à 37 milliards F CFA, pour un chiffre d’affaires prévisionnel de 270 milliards F CFA. La contribution directe du projet au budget de l’Etat s’élève à 84 827 405 843 F CFA. Il est attendu une contribution de 2 704 643 521 F CFA au Fonds minier de développement durant la vie du projet. La mise en œuvre du projet permettra la création et la consolidation de 400 emplois directs et environ 850 emplois indirects. L’adoption de ce décret permet l’octroi d’un permis d’exploitation industrielle de grande mine de zinc à la Société de participation minière du Burkina Faso (SOPAMIB) PERKOA SA. II. COMMUNICATIONS ORALES II.1. Le ministre de la Justice assurant l’intérim du ministre d’Etat, ministre de l’Administration territoriale et de la mobilité a fait au Conseil une communication relative à la célébration du 11 décembre 2026, placée sous le thème « Révolution progressiste populaire au Burkina Faso : une consécration des résistances à la domination coloniale et à l’impérialisme ». Cette manifestation vise à : – réaffirmer la souveraineté nationale ; – témoigner devant le peuple et la communauté internationale de la pleine maîtrise de notre destin national ; – valoriser les efforts de modernisation des équipements militaires et de transformation socio-économique ; – rendre un hommage solennel aux Forces armées nationales et de sécurité intérieure, ainsi qu’aux Volontaires pour la défense de la Patrie et au peuple résilient. La célébration du 11 décembre 2026 sera marquée par une grande parade militaire à Ouagadougou. Par ailleurs, le dispositif national d’organisation a été décliné au niveau régional avec la mise en place dans chaque région d’un comité régional d’organisation présidé par le gouverneur afin de favoriser une forte mobilisation des populations et renforcer les liens de cohésion et d’unité entre le peuple dans ses différentes composantes et son armée. II.2. Le ministre des Serviteurs du Peuple a fait au Conseil le compte rendu de la participation du Burkina Faso aux ateliers d’élaboration du guide commun pour l’harmonisation des pratiques en matière d’embauche des travailleurs migrants, du guide du travailleur migrant et de la convention sur la portabilité des prestations sociales des travailleurs dans l’Alliance des Etats du Sahel (AES). Ces ateliers se sont tenus respectivement du 17 au 21 septembre 2026 et du 17 au 24 septembre 2026 à Niamey, en République du Niger, conformément aux orientations définies dans la feuille de route de l’An II de la Confédération des Etats du Sahel. Cette feuille de route adoptée le 26 février 2026 à Ouagadougou, prévoit, au titre du volet Fonction publique, travail et protection sociale, l’optimisation de la gouvernance de la migration de la main-d’œuvre au sein de l’espace confédéral. La tenue de ces ateliers vise à mieux encadrer la mobilité des travailleurs des Etats membres, à faciliter les démarches administratives liées au recrutement des travailleurs migrants, à renforcer l’accès à l’information sur leurs droits et obligations et à garantir la continuité de leurs droits sociaux. La participation du Burkina Faso aux ateliers de Niamey s’inscrit dans la dynamique de consolidation de la coopération entre les Etats membres de la Confédération en matière de travail et de protection sociale. ‘I’m Not MAGA,’ Says Man in MAGA Hat
items.description: Elon Musk doesn’t know where people got the idea that he’s MAGA. “I’m not MAGA,” he said in an interview yesterday. “I’m not sure what MAGA means.” He went on to describe himself as “ideologically quite moderate” and added, “I don’t think I have, like, any kind of extreme political views.” This is the same Elon Musk who last year took the stage at the Conservative Political Action Conference wearing a black MAGA hat and wielding a chainsaw, has opined that “whites are a rapidly dying minority,” called the left “the party of murder,” posted that he loves Donald Trump “as much as a straight man can love another man,” spearheaded the Trump administration’s DOGE initiative, was the largest individual donor to Republicans in the past two elections, and just two weeks ago urged his 240 million–plus followers to “Vote red today!” on the social-media platform that he bought to wage war on the “woke mind virus.” The world’s richest man, it seems, has changed his tune. The nearly half a billion dollars that he spent supporting Republican candidates in the 2026 midterms? That was aimed only at ensuring “checks and balances” in government, he said onstage at The New York Times ’ DealBook Summit yesterday. After the historic Democratic landslide, the Tesla and SpaceX CEO is trying to do what corporate executives often do: adjust their politics to align with the party in power. Mark Zuckerberg banned Trump from Facebook after the Capitol riot on January 6, 2021; four years later, he was standing alongside Trump on the inauguration dais. Palantir CEO Alex Karp donated $1 million to a pro-Trump PAC in December 2024; last week, he told Politico that he’s a lifelong Democrat and that Palantir’s products are “essentially progressive.” Musk’s conversion might be the least convincing yet. It’s tricky enough for a chameleon like Zuckerberg to mold his politics to the moment; most Republicans didn’t buy him as a dripped-out, flag-waving, mixed-martial-arts fan any more than most Democrats bought Facebook’s “pivot to privacy” in the wake of the Cambridge Analytica data-harvesting scandal . Musk pitching the public on his new persona as a buttoned-down centrist is like Senator Elizabeth Warren starring in a Cybertruck commercial. Musk was not always a right-winger. He has said in the past that he voted for Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, and Joe Biden. His public swerve to the right began during the coronavirus pandemic and fed on his growing resentments about lockdown policies, transgender rights, and the Biden administration’s exclusion of Tesla from a White House event promoting electric vehicles. He moved from California to Texas in 2020, complaining about regulatory burdens, and brought his companies with him. After going all-in on the GOP, Musk now figures to be among the top targets for investigation by a Democrat-led Congress. “They are going to need to plant new forests for all of the subpoenas we’ll be printing,” Senator Ed Markey of Massachusetts posted on Election Day. And Musk’s business empire is in the awkward position of relying on government contracts and regulatory approvals that will be controlled by political leaders whose party and values he has demonized. Nowhere is this problem more acute for Musk than in his adopted home state of Texas, where the Democrats Gina Hinojosa and James Talarico defeated the Republicans he had backed for governor and the Senate, respectively. Both had campaigned against Musk and data centers. (Musk did not respond to a request for comment.) In the past, Musk has criticized politicians who publicly challenged him. When Senator Ron Wyden of Oregon called for a billionaire tax in 2021, he replied with typical delicacy: “Why does ur pp look like u just came?” Since the midterms, however, Musk has exercised uncharacteristic restraint, especially with Hinojosa, who will soon have leverage over not only data centers but also a major planned expansion of SpaceX’s Starbase, Musk’s massive Terafab semiconductor project, and the appointment of judges to the state’s business courts. Two days after the election, he shared a post characterizing Hinojosa’s approach to data centers as “reasonable” and praising her as “a political talent.” That same week, Hinojosa requested a pause on the state’s consideration of a major land sale to SpaceX until she takes office, in January. “We can have a strong working relationship with Elon Musk and his companies, but it has to be on our terms,” she said in a CNN interview. Yesterday, Musk reiterated his openness to working with Hinojosa, whom he called by her first name. “Based on everything I’ve heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor,” he said. Mockable as Musk’s pivot might be, there’s a strategic logic to it that doesn’t depend on anyone actually believing that he’s sincere. He made the comments at a conference aimed at business insiders, investors, and policy makers. Tesla and SpaceX stocks took a hit from the midterm results, and Musk has a long history of temporarily pulling back from partisanship when he feels that his business interests are vulnerable. Investors probably don’t care as much about Musk’s politics as they care whether he remains capable of making that trade-off when needed. Musk has floated merging SpaceX and Tesla into one conglomerate, which would require approval from shareholders. And then there are the Democratic politicians Musk hopes to appease at least enough to keep his federal contacts and push through key business deals. Here, too, he doesn’t need them to believe in his conversion. He just needs to signal that he’s open to finding some common ground. Many politicians, after all, recognize the value of malleability in service of expediency. Musk’s moderation might well prove short-lived if Democrats don’t respond the way he hopes. (After Musk’s comments yesterday, Senator Ruben Gallego of Arizona posted on X: “You are still getting a subpoena.”) Regardless, his sudden circumspection suggests that something significant has already shifted: People watch their words only when they fear consequences. For two years, staying on Trump’s good side was a guarantee of protection for Musk, freeing him to say and do whatever else he wanted. That sense of impunity no longer holds.

items.title: Anthropic becomes one of world’s most valuable public companies in stock market debut
items.description: Anthropic has become one of the world’s most valuable public companies after its shares began trading on the stock market, taking its valuation to roughly $1.76 trillion (£1.34 trillion). The artificial intelligence (AI) company’s Thursday debut on the Nasdaq stock exchange was a crucial test for the industry, given the huge amount of money being poured into advancing the technology. Anthropic’s shares flew past its allocation price of $83 each , showing there was plenty of excitement around AI. Yet the company behind AI chatbot Claude will remain under intense scrutiny in the months ahead to answer the key question surrounding AI: is it all worth it? In just a few hours of trading, Anthropic’s stock seemed to show that investors remain uncertain about where AI is headed. The share price immediately rose to $111.53, sending the company’s market value to almost $2 trillion, before falling by the end of the day to close at $97.17. Some investors said Anthropic’s debut seemed successful, as shares rose roughly 17% during the day, but the broader tech market did not perform as well. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index closed down nearly 2.3%. Stocks fell at the largest tech firms, including Google’s parent company, Alphabet, down 2.9%, while Amazon fell almost 3.9%. The buildout around this era of AI is among the most expensive endeavours in technology history, with a handful of major tech companies spending more than $1 trillion in the last year alone. The rapid growth in investment has fueled ongoing concerns about a financial bubble. “Bubbles don’t burst on the day of the largest deal,” Richard Whittle, an economist at the University of Salford, said. “They burst later, if the positive future becomes suspect.”

items.title: Brighton Anthropic founder to become billionaire
items.description: A man from Brighton who helped to set up the AI company Anthropic, which made its stock market debut on Thursday, is set to become a billionaire. Jack Clark was caught up in the excitement of artificial intelligence and joined OpenAI, where he initially worked in communications, later becoming its policy director. The company behind Anthropic, Claude, was formed by seven people who left rival OpenAI in 2021 and will become multi-billionaires – on paper at least. Clark is the only one of the founder not from North America and is the head of public benefit at Anthropic, also leading the Anthropic Institute, an AI think tank. He studied English literature and creative writing at the University of East Anglia and became a technology journalist, writing for publications including ZDNet UK, The Register, and Bloomberg. ‘Very proud of him’ Nigel Marshall, who taught Clark philosophy at Varndean College, said he was a “very bright person”. He said: “I do remember him. He was incredibly articulate, interested in the world, interested in literature, interested in philosophy. “I can’t say I realised that he was going to be quite as successful as he’s been because he wasn’t a show-off. “He was very quietly spoken, a pleasant character and really, we’re very proud of him at the college.” When the markets opened, shares in Anthropic started at $110 , well above the initial public offering of $83.

items.title: Frank happy to be ‘back in the circus’ at Palace
items.description: Thomas Frank is happy to be “back in the circus” after speaking at his first news conference as Crystal Palace manager. The 53-year-old, who was appointed on a two-and-a-half-year deal on Monday, has been out of worked since he was sacked by Tottenham in February, less than eight months after taking the job. But, rather than dwell on that disappointment, Frank hopes to use it as a learning exeprience as he attempts to improve Palace’s fortunes and lift them off the bottom of the Premier League table. “If you don’t learn from any of your jobs, I don’t think you reflect, I don’t think you improve, and I don’t think you get better,” said Frank. “Of course there’s a lot of things I have been reflecting over. The details, that will be for another time, but I can say I’ve learned, definitely.” The Dane said he could easily have extended his break from football, which he used to travel to Japan and Australia, as well as “visiting friends and family, eating too well [and] drinking too much wine” back in his homeland. “I was very aware I didn’t want to do anything in the summer. I put a statement out there, I needed more time,” he added. “I can actually, honestly say I would have been fine if it was three, four, five, six, seven months more, because it’s good to be back in the circus, but it’s also unbelievably good not to be in, especially if you enjoy life, which I do. “I was spending time with family and friends and doing all that, but I think the club, the way Palace is, how well Steve Parish especially spoke about the club and ideas, Matt Hobbs and Iain Moody and these guys, too, helped convince me it was a good idea. “I’m a little bit surprised by this feeling I have in the body, how good it feels.” Frank’s Palace reign begins with a trip to Coventry City on Saturday (15:00 GMT), and he says he returns to the dugout unbruised despite the way his stint at Spurs ended. “I think we all have an ego,” the former Brentford boss said. “Some are better at controlling it than others. For me, it’s not the critics, it’s more what I can learn, what I can prove, how I can get better. “There’s a lot of clever people out there, but the interesting thing is they only know 10 per cent of the truth. That’s a tenth of the truth at Brentford , there’s a tenth of the truth at Tottenham , and that’s just the way it is. “If you can’t handle that as a coach or a player, then you shouldn’t be in this business, and I’m very happy to be back in the game.”

items.title: ¿Quién ha ganado el duelo? Los analistas de EL PAÍS dan por vencedor a Feijóo sobre Sánchez
items.description: Los dos principales candidatos a presidir el Gobierno ―Pedro Sánchez (PSOE) y Alberto Núñez Feijóo (PP)— se han enfrentado este jueves en el único debate electoral cara a cara de las elecciones generales, que se celebran el domingo, 29 de noviembre. El debate se ha dividido en cinco bloques temáticos: vivienda, economía y fiscalidad; política social y servicios públicos; corrupción y regeneración democrática y, por último, migración y política exterior. Seguir leyendo Berna González Harbour: “Goleada de Feijóo” Si en 2023 Pedro Sánchez perdió el debate, pero ganó la mayoría parlamentaria, esta vez perdió probablemente ambas cosas. Feijóo arrolló con tal munición de acusaciones por la corrupción, Ceuta y la falta de resultados en temas como la vivienda que el presidente apenas pudo estar a la defensiva. Sánchez respondió con buen tono, educación y retahílas de datos a su favor, pero sin conseguir desbaratar la estrategia efectista de Feijóo ni introducir ilusión alguna. El jefe de la oposición le ametralló con apelaciones y preguntas directas –“debería darle vergüenza”, “no me ha contestado”, “aproveche para pedir perdón a las víctimas”, “debería ser más prudente”- y apenas tardó unos segundos en devolverle la acusación que Sánchez lanzó Mariano Rajoy en el debate de 2015: "Usted no es decente". El PP estaba entonces acorralado por Gürtel. Y hoy es Sánchez quien se vio acorralado, no solo por los escándalos, sino por la fatiga de materiales tras ocho años en el poder. El presidente pareció un buen estudiante que se sabía la lección, pero en el aula equivocada. La lluvia de acusaciones fue tan fulminante que solo cabía preguntarse por qué no se retiró a su debido tiempo. Vimos a un Sánchez acorralado y una goleada de Feijóo. Sergio del Molino: “Victoria sin alardes, pero contundente, de Feijóo” La cosa empezó mal para Feijóo, que embutió en sus primeras intervenciones todos los estribillos de las canciones más machacadas de la radiofórmula de la derecha, empezando por la entrevista de Puigdemont en 'El Mundo'. Condensó tantas alusiones antisanchistas, que incluso los espectadores más cafeteros debieron de perderse alguna, y a Pedro Sánchez se le puso cara de ganador: fue una sorpresa, como quien encuentra un billete en un bolsillo, pero se le pasó pronto. A partir del segundo bloque, su oponente cogió tono y lo sacó de la pelea, acorralándolo en ocasiones con preguntas que no obtenían respuesta y obligando al presidente a discursear y a victimizarse con tretas de mal tertuliano (“no me deja usted hablar”). Flojeó el popular con la inmigración, lo que permitió a Sánchez retomar la iniciativa con un alegato muy lúcido que desnudó las deudas voxeras del PP en este asunto. Fue un instante inspirado, pero no le sirvió para remontar un encuentro que ganó Feijóo. Sin alardes, pero con cierta contundencia. Máriam Martínez-Bascuñán: “La victoria de los dos rombos” Un debate no se gana igual cuando se llega con ventaja, y solo hay que conservarla, que cuando hay que remontar. Por eso, lo ocurrido esta noche tiene que medirse con la vara que cada uno traía; Feijóo no se podía equivocar, y Sánchez tenía que conseguir que algo cambiara. Medido así, Feijóo ha salido con lo que venía a buscar, aunque cuesta llamar victoria a una noche en la que quien aspira a gobernar, interrumpiendo con una agresividad que no necesitaba quien solo tiene que conservar su ventaja, ha advertido de que su propio relato necesitaba dos rombos, ha convertido el bloque de vivienda en un repaso de las relaciones de Ábalos y ha llevado al plató al portero de un puticlub. Mientras tanto, un Sánchez demasiado pendiente de no repetir 2023, encontraba tarde su debate y ofreció una versión más sobria de sí mismo sin acabar de resolver esa disyuntiva que recorre el espinazo de la política española: ¿Entrará la extrema derecha en La Moncloa por primera vez en nuestra democracia? “Señor Feijóo, déjeme terminar” fue su frase más repetida. No es un buen lema. Sánchez no quiso bajar al barro, pero quedan 10 días de barro, y solo después sabremos si la marea de ultraderecha anega o no La Moncloa. Jordi Amat: “Feijóo se mostró implacable y así se ha impuesto" A las 23.33, tras haber recibido infinidad de golpes casi sin defenderse, después de muchos minutos de una resignación que podía parecer entre educada y desfondada, Pedro Sánchez colocó por fin el que debía ser su mensaje fundamental para las elecciones del 29N. Afirmó sin titubear que él no está de acuerdo con la política de inmigración de su colega socialdemócrata, que es primera ministra en Dinamarca, para decir después que el canciller conservador alemán no ha pactado con la extrema derecha y, en cambio, el líder del Partido Popular parece que sí lo hará con Vox. Lo dijo con convicción, pero tarde. Había perdido ya. Habían pasado noventa minutos ya para tomar el control de un debate que, a falta de la intervención de la moderadora (la principal ausente), más bien fue un cruce de monólogos en los que Feijóo se mostró implacablemente agresivo y Sánchez tal vez demasiado triste. Por tono y por preparación, interrumpiendo, Feijóo ha evitado entrar en su punto flaco y así se ha impuesto. Hay motivos para que una alianza gubernamental del PP y Vox inquiete a buena parte de la ciudadanía, pero el debate nunca se ha centrado en una discusión sobre ese escenario. Najat el Hachmi: “Feijóo marca el debate mostrándose como un profesor severo" Feijóo ha marcado el debate comportándose como un profesor severo echando la bronca a un alumno que se ha portado mal, sin tregua desde el primer momento en el que la enumeración de las manchas del Gobierno de Sánchez ha empañado todo lo que vino después. El presidente ha mantenido el tipo y la serenidad, poniendo de vez en cuando cara de niño bueno, injustamente castigado, a pesar de las continuas interrupciones del líder del PP y las risitas sarcásticas cuando Sánchez le echaba en cara alguna verdad. Lo más sorprendente del aspirante a ocupar la Moncloa es que proponga bajar impuestos, construir un millón de viviendas sin inmigrantes, subir las pensiones a la vez que aumenta el gasto en defensa. Ha dado la sensación de que todos los aciertos argumentativos de Sánchez quedaban manchados por los puntos oscuros que Feijóo ha explotado sin piedad: su relación con Marruecos y los casos de corrupción. Diego S. Garrocho: “Gana Feijóo” Alberto Núñez Feijóo y Pedro Sánchez llegaban a este debate con objetivos dispares. Para el líder de los populares, a quien gran parte de las encuestadoras otorgan la victoria, el cara a cara podía suponer una suerte de triunfo definitivo. Para el presidente, en cambio, debía ser el revulsivo con el que invertir unos pronósticos poco halagüeños. Era la penúltima bala, a la espera de que algún imprevisto irrumpa en la campaña. Pero el golpe de efecto no llegó. Feijóo arrancó con dureza. Una dureza eficaz cuando situó en el centro de la discusión la corrupción socialista, agravada por los escándalos sexuales, pero incómoda cuando interrumpía a su rival. Sánchez abrió con un extraño lapsus que sería un preludio de su ánimo: llegó a pedirle a su adversario que no derogara la ley de vivienda del Gobierno, como si diera por hecha su derrota. Hubo también una energía desigual. El presidente, normalmente ágil, se mostró frío, mecánico y hasta previsible en su agitación del miedo. Feijóo, en tantas ocasiones torpe, exhibió ganas y determinación. El popular acertó al moralizar el debate (Urda, corrupción, politización de las instituciones) y lo llevó a terrenos difícilmente defendibles para el jefe del Ejecutivo. Daniel Gascón: “Feijóo enérgico, Sánchez abúlico” Los temas del debate eran distintos a los de 2023, pero la impresión no ha sido tan distinta. Alberto Núñez Feijóo se mostró más enérgico y seguro. Conjugó ataques y datos; aportó propuestas. Parecía más ágil, y daba la sensación de conocer las cifras y la gestión. El presidente del Gobierno, que era quien más tenía que ganar, estuvo excesivamente contenido: la humildad resultaba impostada; parecía desganado y errático. Leía documentos y datos que seguramente conoce bien. No escuchaba, ni sabía responder las interrupciones de Feijóo. No estaba cómodo ni en los tramos que teóricamente le favorecían. A menudo recurría a un lenguaje lejano, extraño para el contexto. No habló de Ceuta, ni supo defender el modelo migratorio como en otras ocasiones. El argumento del miedo a la ultraderecha está más desgastado que hace tres años. Aunque Sánchez se fue animando a lo largo del debate, no convenció y probablemente tampoco logró movilizar: quizá el problema no fuera solo de comunicación o preparación del debate, sino que es difícil defender su gestión en una legislatura estéril.

items.title: Leicester City split with sponsor after porn actress row
items.description: Leicester City have parted ways with their main shirt sponsor after the gambling firm appointed a porn actress as an ambassador. BC Game – which was named as a sponsor for the League One side at the start of the 2024-25 season – named Eva Elfie as a brand ambassador earlier this month . The online gambling company posted a video of Elfie and a delivery driver on social media, with the caption: “Welcome to BC Game Eva Elfie! Let the fun begin.” The club, which had faced criticism from fans’ group The Foxes Trust, said it had reached a “mutual agreement” to end its partnership with the firm, and supporters who had bought shirts in the past 28 days could exchange them. Announcing the club’s partnership in 2024, Leicester City said BC Game – which is not available to users in the UK – was a “socially responsible platform” and aimed to provide an “enjoyable and safe gaming experience”. When Elfie was confirmed as BC Game’s brand ambassador, the firm said in a LinkedIn post on 3 November that she had an “established presence in gaming communities”. Chief executive Ali “Ako” Muhanned previously added: “Eva has built an incredible relationship with the gaming and esports community through genuine passion and consistent content creation.” In response, The Foxes Trust said: “Both gambling and pornography can have devastating impacts on people’s lives, in particular young people. “Partnerships like these bring these two worlds to a larger audience and, by association, link them to Leicester City. Is this who we are now?” On Wednesday the club issued a statement, which said it and the sponsor had “reached a mutual agreement to conclude our commercial partnership with immediate effect”. It also thanked the firm for the “constructive approach taken in reaching this agreement”. The statement confirmed an “enhanced returns policy” in which it would accept BC Game-branded shirts bought since 21 October for exchange or refund, even if they had been worn or personalised. The company posted a video announcing its partnership with Eva Elfie on social media The Foxes Trust said it welcomed the decision. “Since the partnership was announced in 2024, the trust has consistently made clear that BC Game, for numerous reasons, does not reflect the values of our club or its supporters,” a spokesperson said. “That view has been shared by the great majority of fans who responded to our surveys. The recent partnership with an adult content creator only deepened those concerns and the trust felt the need to once again speak out publicly. “This statement gained strong traction, emphasising the weight of feeling on this matter. Although we believe that the club should never have gone into partnership with BC Game, we nevertheless welcome this decision to part ways.” A spokesperson for BC Game added: “BC Game confirms that its principal partner sponsorship agreement with Leicester City Football Club has ended. “We thank Leicester City for the partnership and wish the club and its supporters all the best for the future.”

items.title: UNIZIK VC urges 19,522 graduands to uphold discipline, excellence
items.description: By Nwabueze Okonkwo ONITSHA – The Vice-Chancellor of Nnamdi Azikiwe University, Awka, Prof. Ugochukwu Bond Stanley Anyaehie, has urged the 2025 and 2026 graduating students of the institution to uphold its core values of discipline, excellence and self-reliance as they begin the next phase of their lives. Anyaehie gave the charge on Thursday in Awka while delivering his address at the university’s 20th and 21st combined convocation ceremonies. He urged the graduands to become worthy ambassadors of the institution, named after Nigeria’s first President, Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe, popularly known as Zik of Africa. Expounding on the university’s motto, the Vice-Chancellor said discipline required the graduands to make integrity, self-control and ethical conduct their guiding principles in an increasingly complex world. On self-reliance, he advised them not to wait for opportunities to come their way but to embrace innovation, create value, build enterprises and develop solutions to real-life challenges. He also urged them to pursue excellence and reject mediocrity, stressing that every task they undertook should reflect world-class standards. Reflecting on his tenure as the institution’s seventh Vice-Chancellor, Anyaehie reaffirmed his commitment to scholarship, clinical integrity, effective higher education governance, staff development and institutional transformation. He said his administration’s philosophy, “A Greater UNIZIK is Possible,” was not merely a slogan but a commitment to repositioning the university as a globally competitive centre of academic excellence, technological innovation and societal impact. Presenting the convocation statistics, the Vice-Chancellor disclosed that a total of 19,522 graduands would receive various qualifications, comprising 16,260 first-degree recipients and 3,262 postgraduate graduands. Of the first-degree recipients, 213 graduated with First Class Honours, 4,623 obtained Second Class Honours (Upper Division), 8,751 earned Second Class Honours (Lower Division), while 2,116 graduated with Third Class Honours and 71 obtained Pass degrees. Another 486 students received unclassified degrees in Medical and Pharmaceutical Sciences. The postgraduate category comprised 701 Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) recipients, 35 Master of Philosophy/Doctor of Philosophy (MPhil/PhD) recipients, 1,224 master’s degree recipients, 323 Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) recipients and 979 Postgraduate Diploma in Education (PGDE-NTI) recipients. Highlighting his administration’s achievements, Anyaehie said institutional reforms had been implemented to strengthen academic standards, improve staff welfare, expand the university’s capacity and modernise its operations. He also identified the full re-accreditation of the university’s Medical programme by the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN) as a major milestone in its academic and professional development. In his remarks, the Chancellor of the university, His Royal Majesty, Da Jacob Gyang Buba, CON, Gbong Gwom Jos, acknowledged the presence of dignitaries and graduating students and extended greetings to President Bola Tinubu. He paid tribute to the institution’s founding inspiration, Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe, describing his legacy as an enduring source of inspiration. The Chancellor also appreciated the Federal Government, Federal Ministry of Education, National Universities Commission (NUC), benefactors and friends of the university for their financial, infrastructural and moral support. Similarly, the Pro-Chancellor and Chairman of the Governing Council, Barr. Monsur Olugbenga Kukoyi, congratulated the graduating students, describing the convocation as a celebration of perseverance, character and scholarship rather than merely a university tradition. The post UNIZIK VC urges 19,522 graduands to uphold discipline, excellence appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: ‘I’m very healthy’ – Kompany to return to dugout after health scare
items.description: Bayern Munich boss Vincent Kompany says he is “very healthy” and grateful for all of the support he has received as he prepares to return to the dugout on Friday. The 40-year-old former Manchester City captain was taken to hospital after falling ill while watching the club’s second team train last month. Kompany was diagnosed with meningeal irritation – an inflammation of the protective membrane surrounding the brain and spinal cord. Speaking at a news conference on Thursday he thanked the club, medical staff, players, coaches and fans for their support. “It was very intense,” he said. “At the time, it was a new experience. Looking back, everything went perfectly. I received support right away, from the club and the doctors. I’m very grateful. “You try to stay calm and wait until you have the results. It was a positive process, all the tests were positive. “I have to say, I’m very healthy. We did a lot of tests, and they all came back fine. In those quiet moments, you also try to learn. “Now I feel very good again and I’m happy to be back with the team.” While he has been recovering Kompany’s assistant Aaron Danks has led the side to four wins and a draw. “I’d also like to thank the coaching community,” Kompany added. “We’re always competing, but almost every coach has reached out to me, even if we’ve played against each other and perhaps argued as well. That’s a beautiful thing.” Bayern, for whom England captain Harry Kane has been in fine form, are top of the Bundesliga, level on points with Borussia Dortmund. Defending champions Bayern face Cologne on Friday after the end of the two-week international break.

items.title: Ogun polytechnic students protest ASUP strike, seek Abiodun’s intervention
items.description: By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta ABEOKUTA — Students of state-owned polytechnics in Ogun State on Thursday protested at the Governor’s Office, Oke Mosan, Abeokuta, demanding Governor Dapo Abiodun’s urgent intervention to end the lingering industrial dispute between the state government and the Academic Staff Union of Polytechnics (ASUP). The protest, organised by hundreds of students under the aegis of the National Association of Polytechnic Students (NAPS), followed the expiration of two separate 48-hour ultimatums issued to the government without what the students described as concrete action towards resolving the dispute. The strike, which has kept students out of classrooms for about 10 days, has disrupted academic activities across the six state-owned polytechnics. Armed with placards bearing inscriptions such as “Gov. Dapo Abiodun, please end ASUP strike”, “Save Polytechnic Education Now”, “Our Lecturers Must Return to the Classroom” and “Attend to Our Lecturers’ Demands”, the protesters urged the governor to intervene personally and ensure an immediate resolution of the crisis. Speaking during the demonstration, the Chairman of NAPS, Ogun State Liaison Council, Comrade Joshua Opatunmibi, said the students had exhausted available diplomatic channels and could no longer remain silent while their academic future was being jeopardised. He explained that the protest was not intended to confront the state government but to draw attention to the hardship caused by the prolonged strike and demand decisive action. Opatunmibi said the students had made several appeals to the government and issued two 48-hour ultimatums without the desired response. He said: “On November 12, we issued a 48-hour ultimatum to the state government, appealing to Governor Dapo Abiodun to urgently intervene and bring an end to the ongoing ASUP strike. “The 48 hours elapsed without any meaningful action from the government. Consequently, on Monday, we addressed another press conference, appealing to the government to come to our rescue because the strike had stalled our education. We also issued another 48-hour ultimatum. “That ultimatum expired on Wednesday afternoon, but we were disappointed that nothing had been done to address our concerns. We are really unhappy. Does it mean that the government does not care about our plight? “The closure of all the polytechnics in the state is seriously affecting us. We cannot continue to sit at home while our academic programmes and future plans are being put on hold. “We are here to demonstrate that the voices of students matter. We are not fighting the government; we are simply demanding that the issues responsible for this strike be resolved. “We cannot continue to put our future in jeopardy. We appeal to Governor Abiodun to please attend to the demands of our lecturers so that we can return to our respective institutions and complete our education.” Also speaking, a NAPS member, Kolade Musbau, expressed disappointment over what he described as the government’s lack of urgency in resolving the dispute, saying students were bearing the brunt of the industrial action. Musbau lamented that students who should be attending lectures and progressing with their academic programmes had been forced to remain at home, threatening their ability to complete their studies within the stipulated period. He said: “The students are not happy that, instead of being in school, we are at home wasting valuable time because of this ASUP strike. Despite our repeated appeals, it appears that the government is not ready to do the needful. “We have, therefore, been left with no option but to embark on this protest to draw the government’s attention to our plight and demand urgent intervention to end the strike. “We are all eager to return to our respective institutions and complete our studies within the expected period. We appeal to Governor Abiodun to bring this strike to an end without further delay.” Responding on behalf of the state government, the Permanent Secretary, Bureau of Cabinet and Special Services, Mr Dolamu Idowu-Agida, assured the protesters that the government was making efforts to resolve the disagreement with the lecturers. Idowu-Agida disclosed that the government had held two meetings with relevant stakeholders to address the issues surrounding the industrial action. He also revealed that approval had been granted for an increase in the monthly subvention to all state-owned polytechnics, expressing optimism that the strike would be called off within 48 hours. He said: “I want to assure you that the state government has held meetings with relevant stakeholders on this matter twice. The government is seriously addressing your concerns. “As of yesterday, approval had been granted for an increase in the subvention to all the polytechnics in the state. “The issues raised by your lecturers are receiving serious consideration. I want to assure you that the matter will soon be resolved and your lecturers will return to the classrooms. “Be rest assured that your lecturers should be back in the classrooms within the next 48 hours.” It will be recalled that lecturers in the six state-owned polytechnics in Ogun State embarked on an indefinite strike last Wednesday following the expiration of a 15-day ultimatum issued to the state government to address their outstanding demands. The industrial action followed the alleged non-implementation of the Consolidated Academic Tools Allowance (CATA) and Earned Academic Allowance (EAA), as well as concerns over what the union described as inadequate funding of the institutions. ASUP had also faulted the government’s continued payment of a monthly subvention of N5 million to some of the state-owned polytechnics, arguing that the amount had remained unchanged for more than a decade despite prevailing economic realities and rising operational costs. Among its major demands, the union is seeking payment of outstanding CATA and EAA entitlements, as well as an immediate review and upward adjustment of the monthly subvention to N100 million for all state-owned polytechnics. The union maintained that increased funding was necessary to meet the institutions’ operational needs, improve the quality of education and ensure effective delivery of academic programmes. The post Ogun polytechnic students protest ASUP strike, seek Abiodun’s intervention appeared first on Vanguard News .
